name: 2 Timothy
description: Remembered faith · chains · patient correction · Scripture · departure
limits: Paul is the named letter speaker. Historical authorship, dates, Greek forms, manuscripts, and a complete harmony of the travel notices were not independently verified. No exact prison site is assigned.
review: All 83 verses read for four original contextual explanations and exact selections. Five selected profiles and three city references do not claim exhaustive coverage. Actual Church discussion supplies its chapter scope. Skinner's interpretation remains attributed. Authorship, dates, and a complete travel harmony were not independently verified.

sources.title: October 23–29 · Timothy, Titus, and Philemon
sources.author: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints
sources.publisher: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints
sources.summary: The lesson connects courage, Scripture, and continued faithful teaching.
sources.limits: Second Timothy coverage follows actual discussion of chapters one, three, and four. Linked talks and Restoration passages were not independently reviewed.

reviewed.scope: Complete lesson body and resources read. Only its actual Second Timothy discussion supports these Church references.

sources.title: Commentary on 2 Timothy 3:14—4:5
sources.author: Matt Skinner
sources.summary: Skinner emphasizes Scripture's usefulness for faithful service and patient teaching.
sources.limits: This is Skinner's interpretation. His Greek analysis, authorship discussion linked elsewhere, and a reconstructed history of Scripture were not independently verified.

reviewed.scope: Complete commentary body read. The guide attributes his emphasis on Scripture's usefulness for Timothy's work.

people.name: Paul
people.role: Named letter speaker who recalls chains, abandonment, and the approach of his departure
people.relations: He asks Timothy to continue teaching and come with needed belongings.
people.meaning: His confident hope remains connected with dependence on support and forgiveness for absent helpers.

people.name: Timothy
people.role: Addressed worker charged with preserving teaching and patiently correcting others
people.relations: His grandmother Lois and mother Eunice are remembered for sincere faith.
people.meaning: The letter connects his public task with faith received through personal relationships.

people.name: Jesus Christ
people.role: Risen Lord whose promised life supports endurance and continued teaching
people.relations: Paul connects resurrection, future judgment, and the reward for faithfulness with him.
people.meaning: His promised life makes continued service meaningful despite chains and the approach of death.

people.name: Titus
people.role: Worker whose departure for Dalmatia appears among the closing travel notices
people.relations: The letter names his journey while asking Timothy to come soon.
people.meaning: His brief notice places the final appeal within a wider network of workers.

people.name: Tychicus
people.role: Worker whom the speaker says he sent to Ephesus
people.relations: His sending appears beside the request for Timothy to bring Mark.
people.meaning: His brief notice connects the speaker's needs with continuing work elsewhere.

places.summary: Rome is where Onesiphorus sought the chained speaker.
Ephesus appears in remembered service and the sending of Tychicus.
Corinth is named in the closing notice about Erastus.

1.question: How does remembered family faith support courage before present danger?
1.teaching: The selected Church lesson teaches courage through power, love, and a sound mind.

2.question: Why must correction remain gentle when false teaching harms others?

3.question: How does Scripture's usefulness lead into good work rather than knowledge alone?
3.teaching: The selected Church lesson teaches that Scripture can make readers wise for salvation.

4.question: Why do ordinary requests remain beside confident language about completion and reward?
4.teaching: The selected Church lesson teaches continued faithfulness when hearers prefer false teaching.
